What do I need to get started?

A Mac, a supported Linux computer, or Docker, plus a model connection for AI features. The source install needs Git and Node.js 22 or newer. Keep your host running for scheduled work and remote access. Model providers and connected services may charge for usage.

Where does my data go?

OpenAGI keeps agent state on your host. Your configured cloud model receives selected prompts and tool context, and connected services process the requests you send them. Supported local models can keep inference on your device. Screen observation is optional; external writes and computer actions have their own permissions. Read about privacy and control.

How do I use it on my phone?

The iOS and Android apps include tasks, chat, approvals, and Supervisor. They are currently source / QA builds, with no public app-store download advertised. Pair an available build with a reachable host. See mobile availability and setup.
